start.text: Thornwold comes out of the grey all at once: a black wall of pines, a stony cove, a plank jetty stacked with sacks. Nothing burns on the island's height.
Thornwold landing. I'll lie here a few tides; the camp's charcoal wants shipping. When you want Saltmarrow again, find me on the jetty.
It smells like the inside of a resin pot! Can I go and look at everything? I'm going to look at everything.
Up the slope, past the log piles and a bunkhouse, the old cart road runs north into the pines, and stops at a wall of thorns.
